message: packageManager in package.json (line 4) pins yarn@4.18.1, but Node.js 26 in GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/ci.yml, the job at line 3) does not come with Corepack (Node.js 25.0.0 stopped distributing it), and Corepack is what reads that pin: without a separate Corepack install, yarn there is whatever Yarn is installed, or none
fix: Install Corepack in the job at line 3 of .github/workflows/ci.yml before it runs yarn (a step that runs npm install -g corepack, then corepack enable)
